strategy.drawTarget: Five starting cards plus total owned Action draw >= total deck size + 2
strategy.devotion: At least two Athena Actions in play before favored worship
strategy.worship: Favor Academy gains, reserve eight coins for Acropolis, stop developing in final round or with one Acropolis remaining
strategy.opening: Oracle at three coins, Council at four, Academy at five, Talent at six
strategy.scoring: Acropolis whenever affordable; smaller VP piles late
strategy.limitations: No proactive starter trashing; one Council target; static draw-capacity estimate does not guarantee that draw cards are reached in time.
